subject.title: Improve macOS onboarding UX and gateway setup

question: Should maintainers close this stale macOS onboarding PR as superseded by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99767 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99935, or sponsor a narrow rebase/cherry-pick of any remaining UI improvements?
rationale: The protected `maintainer` label blocks automated cleanup, and the branch now intersects security, auth-provider, and current onboarding product direction decisions that should not be resolved by repair automation.

options.title: Close as superseded
options.body: Close this PR after maintainer confirmation and route any remaining short-screen, remote trust, or AI-access checks to the newer narrower open items.

options.title: Rebase and narrow
options.body: Ask for a fresh branch on current main that keeps only still-needed UI work and fixes the credentialed probe, acknowledgement bypass, and auth-upgrade behavior before review.

options.title: Keep for design discussion
options.body: Leave this PR open only as a historical reference while the remaining macOS remote Gateway direction is handled in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/90665.

recommendation.title: Close as superseded
recommendation.body: Close this PR after maintainer confirmation and route any remaining short-screen, remote trust, or AI-access checks to the newer narrower open items.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the recent merged macOS onboarding setup direction that most directly supersedes this branch.
